samples.label: Arbetssituation (självrapporterat) efter utbildningsnivå, kön och år. by Employment situation, Percentage and confidence interval, Education, Age, Sex and Year
samples.source: The Public Health Agency of Sweden, the national public health survey
note: As of 2024, all the statistics are included in Sweden's official statistics (SOS). In 2022 only some of the statistics were included as official statistics. Statistics for the years before 2022 were produced according to similar standards but do not have a declaration of quality. Read more about this in the quality declaration (in Swedish).'Kvalitetsdeklaration'

The results presented are based on questions asked in the national public health survey: Are you worried about losing your job in the coming 12 months? In the past 12 months, how many days have you been away from work as a result of poor health?
Covers employed, aged 25 to 64.

The national public health survey is a sample survey of the country's population aged 16 and older. The population aged 16 to 84 are covered before 2021. The values presented are not adjusted for age.

From 2021, individuals aged 25 and older are included in the statistics. Over the period 2010-2020, individuals aged 25-84 years are included in the statistics. Over the period 2004-2009, individuals aged 25-74 years are included in the statistics.
